# Changelog

## 1.1.0 - 2026-08-04

### Added

- Added `drdds/msg/FaultEvent` for reporting fault time, code, name, severity, and diagnostic context.
- Added `drdds/msg/FaultEventArray` for publishing a complete snapshot of currently active faults; an empty snapshot means that no faults are currently active.

## 1.0.0

- Initial public DEEPRobotics ROS 2 message and service package.
